summary: Phase-1 backend testing complete. All 6 pytest tests passed (6/6 = 100%) covering both new endpoints (TMAY evaluate, 30-day roadmap), the upgraded speaking-score 5-axis schema, the per-user quota guard (429 with detail.code='user_quota_exceeded'), and regressions for /api/system/config and /api/ai/tutor/chat.
critical_code_review_comments: ai_routes.py is now 957 lines — recommend splitting into modules (tutor.py, speaking.py, tmay.py, roadmap.py, interview.py, vocab.py, media.py) for maintainability.

TMAY transcript Pydantic schema enforces min_length=3 but the request brief implies ~50-word intros. Consider adding a min_words guard or a soft hint in the system prompt for very short transcripts so scores still vary realistically.

Roadmap backfill silently pads to 30 days with a generic placeholder if the LLM under-returns — this can mask provider quality regressions. Recommend logging a warning when backfill triggers, or retrying once with a stricter prompt before padding.

Speaking score model is hardcoded to 'claude-sonnet-4-6' without fallback chain (unlike tutor_chat which uses _send_with_fallback). A single provider outage will 500 the endpoint. Suggest wrapping speaking_score / tmay_evaluate / roadmap_generate in _send_with_fallback as well.
_record() swallows all exceptions silently — quota counters could drift if mongo is briefly down. Consider logging the exception at WARNING level.
TMAY response model defaults all score fields and feedback to defaults if AI returns junk — fine for resilience, but consider a 502 if overall=0 AND polished_version='' (signals model truly failed).
test_credentials: None required — EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is in backend/.env. Tests use synthetic X-User-Id values like qa-tmay-shape-<rand>.
seed_data_creation: Quota test seeds one doc in MongoDB collection `user_usage` for a unique uid='qa-tmay-quota-<rand>' with calls=limit, then deletes it in teardown. No persistent test data left in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_phase1_endpoints.py is reusable. Note: TMAY quota test seeds mongo directly (collection user_usage) instead of firing 31 real LLM calls to avoid ~5+ minute runtime; this still exercises the _guard → check_user_quota path. If you want a true end-to-end 31-call test, run it manually but expect ~3-5 min. Full run took 87s. BASE_URL is localhost:8001 since this is FastAPI-only preview (mobile app is Expo / separate). All 6 LLM-dependent endpoints (Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.2) responded correctly in this run.
